limitations: This validates bounded ownership, retry and copy behavior only; it is not a throughput comparison or policy selection.
Caller-reserved storage is an explicit reservation, not a whole-process memory measurement.
KEEP holds at most the configured two scratch slots in this synchronous test; no provider I/O, cancellation or acknowledgement lease is exercised.
